senses.gloss:
शोण् शोण् (perhaps to be regarded as a
Nom. fr. शोण below), cl. 1. P. शोणति,
शुशोण, शोणितुम्, to be or become red; to go,
move, approach: Caus. शोणयति, -यितुम्, Aor.
अशुशोणत्.

शोण, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (thought by some to be fr.
स-वर्ण), coloured like the red lotus, red, crimson,
of a crimson or chesnut colour; red in the face (from
passion &c.); brown, bay; yellow; (अस्), m. the
colour of the red lotus, red, crimson (the colour);
fire or the god of fire; a sort of red sugar-cane; a
chesnut or bay horse; a particular ocean; the river
Śoṇa or Sone (sometimes written शोणा, f.; it rises
in Gondwana in the district of Nagpore, on the
table-land of Amara-kaṇṭaka, four or five miles east
of the source of the Narma-dā or Nerbudda, and
running first northerly and then easterly for five
hundred miles falls into the Ganges above Pāṭali-
putra or Patna); the plant Bignonia Indica; a proper
N.; (अम्), n. blood; red-lead, minium; [cf. Slav.
sini.]
—शोण-झिण्टिका, f. a kind of red Barleria.
—शोण-झिण्टी, f., N. of two plants (= कुरुवक,
कण्टकिनी).
—शोण-नद, N. of a river.
—शोण-
पत्त्र, अस्, m. ‘red-leaved,’ a red kind of hogweed.
—शोण-पद्मक, अम्, n. a red lotus.
—शोण-
पुष्पक, अस्, m. ‘red-flowered,’ the Kovidāra tree.
—शोण-पुष्पी, f. ‘red-flowered,’ a kind of plant
(= सिन्दूर-पुष्पी).
—शोण-रत्न, अम्, n. a red
[]
gem; a ruby.
—शोण-सङ्गम, अस्, m. ‘Śoṇa-con-
fluence,’ N. of a place.
—शोणाम्बु (˚ण-अम्˚), उस्,
m. ‘having crimson waters or having waters of
blood,’ N. of one of the seven clouds at the destruc-
tion of the world.
—शोणाश्मन् (˚ण-अश्˚), आ, m. a
red stone; a ruby.
—शोणोपल (˚ण-उप्˚), अस्, m.
a red stone; a ruby.
—शोणोल्लीढ (˚ण-उल्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, sharpened or polished on a whetstone.

शोणक, अस्, m. the plant Bignonia or Calosanthes
Indica, (this plant has many synonyms; cf. कुटन्-
नट, नट, मण्डूक-पर्ण.)

शोणित, अस्, आ, अम्, red, crimson, purple; (अम्),
n. blood; saffron.
—शोणित-चन्दन, अम्, n. red
sandal.
—शोणित-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking blood;
blood-sucking.
—शोणित-पारणा, f. ‘breakfast of
blood,’ a meal of flesh-meat.
—शोणित-पुर, अम्,
n. the city of the Asura Vāṇa (= वाण-पुर).
—शोणित-वर्णन, अम्, n. description of the nature
and properties of blood.
—शोणित-वर्णनीय, अस्, आ,
अम्, treating of the above.
—शोणित-विन्दु-वर्षिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, showering drops of blood.
—शोणित-स्नात,
अस्, आ, अम्, bathed in blood.
—शोणितादिग्ध (˚त-
आद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, blood-stained.
—शोणितार्शिन् (˚त-
अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ, suffering from piles attended with
excretions of blood.
—शोणिताह्वय (˚त-आह्˚), अम्,
n. ‘blood-named,’ saffron.
—शोणितोक्षित (˚त-उक्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, blood-stained, sprinkled with blood.
—शोणितोत्पल (˚त-उत्˚), अम्, n. a red lotus.
—शो-
णितोपल (˚त-उप्˚), अस्, m. ‘blood-stone,’ a ruby,
(according to some also अम्, n.)
—शोणितौघ
(˚त-ओघ), अस्, m. a torrent or stream of blood.
शोणिमन्, आ, m. redness, the quality of being red.
